alternate_titles: Letter of the Holy Father Francis to the Bishops of the whole world, that accompanies the Apostolic Letter Motu Proprio data Traditionis custodes
work.author: Pope Francis
work.description: Francis's letter of 16 July 2021 explaining the reasons for Traditionis custodes: the 2020 consultation of the bishops, the judgment that the concessions of John Paul II and Benedict XVI were exploited to widen gaps, the connection drawn between instrumental use of the 1962 Missal and rejection of the Second Vatican Council, and the stated intention to re-establish a single expression of the lex orandi.
work.title: Letter to the Bishops of the Whole World Accompanying Traditionis custodes
